_about: Spiko dictionary: simple A1-A2 meanings by base form. _forms maps irregular forms to their base word.

a.def: one; used before a thing you name for the first time

a.m..def: in the morning; used for times from midnight to noon
a.m..ex: Adam wakes up at 7 a.m. every day.

about.ex: Lina tells Mom about her day at school.

accept.def: to say yes to something someone offers you
accept.ex: Adam accepts the job offer with a big smile.

accountant.def: a person whose job is to work with money and numbers
accountant.ex: My uncle is an accountant at a big bank.

ad.def: a short notice that tells people about a job or product
ad.ex: Lina saw an ad for a new phone.

adam.def: a man's name; Adam Fares is the hero of the stories
adam.ex: Adam wants to find his first job.

afraid.def: feeling fear; worried that something bad will happen

agent.def: a person who works for a company and helps people
agent.ex: The agent answered my question on the phone.

ago.ex: Adam finished university two months ago.

alarm.def: a clock or phone sound that wakes you up
alarm.ex: My alarm rings at seven every morning.

all.ex: All my friends have jobs now.

almost.def: nearly; not completely, but very close

always.ex: Dad always drinks coffee in the morning.

and.def: joins two words or ideas together
and.ex: Adam and Sami drink coffee together.

another.ex: Can I have another cup of tea?

answer.def: what you say or write after someone asks a question
answer.ex: Adam knows the answer to this question.

anywhere.ex: I can't find my keys anywhere.

applause.def: the sound of people clapping their hands to show they like something

apply.def: to ask in writing for a job or a place
apply.ex: Adam wants to apply for a job at BlueLine.

arrive.def: to come to a place at the end of a trip
arrive.ex: We arrive at the office at nine.

ask.def: to say a question to someone
ask.ex: Adam asks Sami about his job.

at.def: shows the place or time where something is
at.ex: Mom is at the market now.

aunt.def: the sister of your mother or father

bachelor.def: a first university degree, after about four years of study
bachelor.ex: Lina wants a bachelor's degree in science.

bad.ex: I feel bad when I am late.

bag.def: a soft container you use to carry things
bag.ex: She puts the bread in a bag.

bank.def: a place that keeps people's money safe
bank.ex: Dad goes to the bank every Monday.

battle.def: a big fight between two armies or groups
battle.ex: The soldiers were tired after the battle.

be.def: used to say what or where someone or something is
be.ex: I want to be a teacher.

because.ex: I am tired because I worked late.

before.ex: Wash your hands before you eat.

beginning.def: the first part or start of something
beginning.ex: The beginning of the movie was boring.

believe.def: to think that something is true
believe.ex: Mom believes Adam will get a good job.

best.def: better than all others; also used to wish people well
best.ex: This is the best tea in Cairo!

big.def: very important; also, large in size
big.ex: Graduation is a big day for Adam.

blueline.def: the name of the company where Adam wants to work
blueline.ex: Adam has an interview at BlueLine Communications.

breakfast.def: the first meal of the day, in the morning
breakfast.ex: We eat eggs and bread for breakfast.

breath.def: the air you take into your body and let out
breath.ex: Take a deep breath and relax.

breathe.def: to take air in and out through your nose or mouth
breathe.ex: Breathe slowly when you feel nervous.

brother.def: a boy or man with the same parents as you

building.def: a structure with walls and a roof, like a house or office
building.ex: The office is in a tall building.

business.def: the work of buying, selling, and making money
business.ex: Lina wants to study business at university.

busy.def: having a lot of work or things to do
busy.ex: Dad is busy at work today.

but.def: used to show something different or surprising
but.ex: I am tired, but I am happy.

buy.def: to get something by paying money for it
buy.ex: Dad wants to buy a new car.

by.def: shows how something is done or sent

bye.def: a short, friendly way to say goodbye

café.def: a small place where you buy drinks and food

cairo.ex: Adam lives with his family in Cairo.

call.def: a phone talk; call center is an office answering phones

calm.def: relaxed and quiet; not worried, angry, or excited

can.ex: Adam can speak English and Arabic.

can't.def: short for cannot; not able to do something

candidate.def: a person who wants a job and is being chosen
candidate.ex: Nadia talked to five candidates today.

car.def: a machine with four wheels that people drive
car.ex: Uncle drives a small white car.

celebrate.def: to do something fun for a happy event
celebrate.ex: We celebrate Lina's birthday with a cake.

center.def: a place where people do a special kind of work
center.ex: Sami works at a call center.

ceremony.def: a special event for an important day
ceremony.ex: The graduation ceremony starts at ten.

certificate.def: an official paper that shows you finished a course
certificate.ex: Adam put his certificate on the wall.

chance.def: a time when you can try to do something
chance.ex: Give me a chance to explain.

check.def: to look at something to see if it is OK or new
check.ex: Please check your email for the message.

clean.def: to make something free of dirt
clean.ex: Lina cleans the kitchen after dinner.

clearly.def: in a way that is easy to hear or understand
clearly.ex: Please speak clearly on the phone.

close.def: to shut something, like a door
close.ex: Please close the window. It's cold.

clothes.def: things you wear, like shirts, pants, and dresses
clothes.ex: Adam puts his clothes in the closet.

coffee.def: a hot brown drink many people have in the morning

come.def: to appear or happen; also, to move toward someone
come.ex: Come to the kitchen, dinner is ready!

commerce.ex: Adam studied commerce at Cairo University.

communication.def: sharing information with others by talking, writing, or phones
communication.ex: Good communication is important at work.

company.def: a business where many people work together
company.ex: Sami works for a big company.

compare.def: to look at two things and see how they are alike
compare.ex: Lina compares the prices of two phones.

computer.def: an electronic machine for work, writing, and the internet
computer.ex: I write my emails on the computer.

confident.def: sure that you can do something well
confident.ex: Adam feels confident before his interview.

congratulations.def: what you say when someone does something good
congratulations.ex: Congratulations on your new job, Adam!

contact.def: touching or meeting; eye contact means looking at someone's eyes

conversation.def: a talk between two or more people

couldn't.def: short for could not; was not able to

course.def: a group of lessons about one subject
course.ex: I am taking an English course online.

customer.def: a person who buys things or uses a company's service

cv.def: a paper about your education, skills, and work
cv.ex: Send your CV to the company by email.

dad.def: a word for father; Adam's father in the stories
dad.ex: Dad reads the newspaper every morning.

day.def: a time of 24 hours; also a special date

dear.def: a kind word for someone you love; also starts letters
dear.ex: Dear Sami, thank you for your help.

decide.def: to choose what to do after thinking
decide.ex: Adam decided to study English every day.

deep.def: big and full, going far down or in

degree.def: what you get when you finish university
degree.ex: Adam has a degree in commerce.

department.def: one part of a big company, school, or shop

didn't.ex: I didn't sleep well last night.

die.def: for a machine: to stop working because it has no power
die.ex: My laptop died in the middle of class.

different.ex: My sister and I like different food.

difficult.def: not easy; needing a lot of work or skill
difficult.ex: The math test was very difficult.

dinner.def: the meal people eat in the evening
dinner.ex: The family eats dinner together at eight.

disaster.def: something that goes very, very badly
disaster.ex: The party was a disaster because it rained.

do.def: to finish an action or a job
do.ex: I do my homework after school.

doctor.def: a person whose job is to help sick people
doctor.ex: Mom took Lina to the doctor.

door.def: the thing you open to go into a room

dream.def: something you want very much; also, pictures while sleeping
dream.ex: My dream is to travel to London.

drive.def: to control a car and make it move
drive.ex: Dad drives to work every day.

during.def: in the time when something is happening
during.ex: Please don't talk during the movie.

early.def: before the usual or planned time
early.ex: Adam wakes up early on interview day.

easy.def: not hard; simple to do or understand

eat.def: to put food in your mouth and swallow it

eight.ex: The shop opens at eight in the morning.

email.def: a message you send on a computer or phone
email.ex: I got an email from the company.

empty.ex: The fridge is empty. Let's go shopping.

end.def: the last part of something; when it stops
end.ex: We watched the movie to the end.

english.def: the language people speak in the USA, UK, and other countries

enjoy.def: to like doing something; to have a good time
enjoy.ex: I enjoy playing football with my friends.

evening.def: the part of the day between afternoon and night
evening.ex: We watch TV together in the evening.

event.def: a special or important thing that happens
event.ex: The wedding is a big family event.

ever.def: at any time in your life
ever.ex: Have you ever been to Alexandria?

every.def: each one, with none left out

everyone.def: all people; every person in a group
everyone.ex: Everyone in the family loves Mom's food.

exactly.def: used to say something is completely right
exactly.ex: Yes, that's exactly what I mean.

exam.def: an important test at school or university
exam.ex: Lina studies hard for her math exam.

example.def: one thing that shows what others are like
example.ex: Give me an example of a good answer.

excellent.ex: Adam's teacher said his work was excellent.

except.ex: I work every day except Friday.

expensive.ex: That suit is too expensive for me.

experience.def: skill you get from doing a job for some time
experience.ex: Sami has two years of experience.

eye.def: one of the two parts of your face you see with

fail.def: to not pass or not do something well
fail.ex: Sami failed his first test, but he tried again.

failure.def: not getting the result you wanted
failure.ex: One failure does not mean you are bad.

fall.def: to go down to the ground suddenly
fall.ex: Be careful, don't fall on the stairs!

family.def: a group of people like parents, children, brothers, and sisters

fancy.ex: They ate at a fancy restaurant.

far.ex: The office is far from my house.

fares.def: a family name; Adam Fares is the hero of the stories

fast.def: quick; moving or doing something at high speed
fast.ex: The taxi driver drives very fast.

feel.def: to have an emotion, like happy or sad

few.ex: I waited a few minutes for the bus.

find.def: to get something after looking for it

finish.def: to complete something; to come to the end
finish.ex: Adam finished his homework before dinner.

first.def: number one in order; the first day of a month
first.ex: My first day at work is on Sunday.

fit.def: to be the right size for you

five.ex: Adam has five interview questions to practice.

fix.def: to make something right or good again
fix.ex: Dad can fix the old radio.

focus.def: to give all your attention to one thing
focus.ex: I can't focus when the TV is on.

football.def: a game where two teams kick a ball

for.def: shows the reason, purpose, person, or time of something

forty.ex: There are forty people at the wedding.

forward.def: toward the front or the future

four.ex: We have four people in our family.

free.def: costing no money; also, able to do what you want
free.ex: The online English course is free.

fresh.ex: Lina buys fresh bread every morning.

friday.def: the day of the week after Thursday

friend.def: a person you like and know well

from.def: shows where something starts or comes from

front.def: the place right before something or someone

full.def: complete; full-time means working all the usual work hours

fun.def: something you enjoy; a good time
fun.ex: The party was a lot of fun.

funny.ex: Sami told a funny story at the café.

get.def: to receive or be given something
get.ex: I got a message from Sami.

gift.def: something you give to someone, like for a birthday

give.ex: Mom gives me breakfast every morning.

go.def: to move or travel to another place
go.ex: Let's go to the café after work.

goal.def: something you want to do in the future
goal.ex: My goal is to speak English well.

good.def: nice, happy, or of high quality

graduate.def: to finish university; also a person who finished

graduation.def: the day or party when you finish university or school

grow.def: to get bigger, or to learn and become better
grow.ex: I want to grow in my new job.

hall.def: a big room or building for events
hall.ex: The party is in a large hall.

handle.def: to deal with a problem or situation

happen.def: to take place; to come about

happy.ex: Adam is happy with his new job.

hard.def: needing a lot of effort; not easy
hard.ex: Finding a job is hard work.

have.def: to own or hold something; also, to get or receive
have.ex: I have two brothers and one sister.

he.def: used for a man or boy already talked about
he.ex: Adam is tired, so he goes to bed.

hear.def: to get sounds with your ears

heavy.def: a lot of; also weighing much
heavy.ex: There was heavy rain last night.

hello.def: a word you say when you meet someone or answer the phone

help.def: to make something easier for someone
help.ex: Lina helps Mom in the kitchen.

here.ex: Come here and sit with me.

hey.def: a friendly word to say hello or get attention

hi.def: a short, friendly way to say hello

himself.def: the same man or boy; used after he

hire.ex: The company wants to hire new workers.

his.ex: Adam is looking for his phone.

hmm.def: a sound people make when they are thinking
hmm.ex: Hmm, I'm not sure. Let me think.

home.ex: Adam goes home after the interview.

horn.def: the part of a car that makes a loud beep sound

how.def: used to ask about the way something happens or is done

hr.def: the office that finds and looks after workers

hundred.ex: There are a hundred people in the hall.

i.def: a word for yourself, the person speaking

idea.def: a plan or thought in your mind

if.def: used to talk about something that may happen

important.ex: This interview is very important for Adam.

impression.def: what people think or feel about you when they meet you

interest.def: wanting to know about or do something

interview.def: a meeting where someone asks you questions for a job

it's.def: short for it is or it has

job.def: the work you do to get money

just.ex: Just call me when you arrive.

keyboard.def: the part of a computer with keys for typing

kind.def: a type or group of something

kitchen.def: the room where you cook food

knock.def: to hit a door with your hand to say you're there

know.def: to have information in your mind

laptop.def: a small computer you can carry

last.def: coming at the end, after all others

late.def: after the right or planned time

learn.def: to get new knowledge or a new skill

leave.def: to go away from a place

let.def: to allow; let me means I will now

life.def: the time you are alive and the things you do

like.def: would like means want, said politely

lina.def: a girl's name; Lina is Adam's sister

listen.def: to pay attention to sounds or words

living.def: living room: the room where a family sits together

long.def: taking a lot of time; also, big from end to end

look.def: to turn your eyes to see something

lot.def: a lot means many or much

luck.def: good things that happen by chance

machine.def: a thing with parts that does work for people

manager.def: a person who leads a team or office

match.def: a game between two teams or players

maybe.def: perhaps; it is possible but not sure

mean.def: to have a certain meaning; to say the same as

meet.def: to see and talk to someone at a place

mistake.def: something you do wrong, but not on purpose

mona.def: a woman's name; Mona is an example graduate

month.def: one of twelve parts of a year

more.def: a bigger amount; again or extra

morning.def: the early part of the day, before noon

most.def: more than all others; the biggest amount

mother.def: a woman who has a child; mom

move.def: to go to another place or position

movie.def: a story you watch on a screen

much.def: a lot; used to make words stronger

myself.def: used when I do something to or for me

name.def: the word people call you or a thing

need.def: to must have something; it is very important

neighbor.def: a person who lives near you

nervous.def: a little afraid or worried about something

never.def: not at any time; not once

new.def: just made, started, or bought; not old

news.def: new information about something that happened

night.def: the dark time of the day, when people sleep

no.def: used to say something is not true or to refuse

normal.def: usual; what you expect; not strange

not.def: used to make a sentence mean the opposite

nothing.def: not anything; no things at all

notification.def: a short message on your phone that tells you something new

number.def: a word or sign like 1, 2, or 3

of.def: shows that something belongs to or is part of something

offer.def: to say you will give something to someone

office.def: a room or building where people work

official.def: done in the correct, formal way, like a company or government

ok.def: used to say yes, fine, or all right

old.def: used to say a person's age

on.def: shows a day or date; also on top of

open.def: to move something so people can go in or through

opportunity.def: a good chance to do something

orange.def: a round, sweet fruit with a thick orange skin

other.ex: Sami has other friends at work.

our.ex: Our house is near the park.

outside.def: not in a building; out of a place

p.m..def: after twelve noon; in the afternoon or evening

part.def: one piece of a bigger thing

pause.def: to stop for a short time

people.def: men, women, and children; more than one person

phone.def: a small machine you use to talk to people

plan.def: a list of steps you decide to do

problem.def: something difficult that you need to fix

professional.def: acting in a serious, good way at work

provide.def: to give something that people need

read.def: to look at words and understand them

send.def: to make something go to another person or place

serious.def: not laughing or joking; thinking carefully

service.def: help or work you do for customers

shirt.def: a piece of clothing for the top part of your body

should.def: used to say what is good or right to do

sleep.def: to rest at night with your eyes closed

smile.def: to make a happy face with your mouth

so.ex: I am so happy for you!

solve.def: to find the answer to a problem

some.def: a number or amount of something, but not all

sound.def: to seem a certain way from what you hear

sunday.def: the day of the week after Saturday

taxi.def: a car you pay to take you somewhere

teacher.def: a person whose job is to help students learn

team.def: a group of people who work together

tell.def: to give information to someone by speaking

terrible.ex: The traffic was terrible this morning.

test.def: questions or tasks to check what you know or can do

thank.def: to say you are happy about someone's help

thanks.def: a short, friendly way to say thank you

that.def: points to a thing already said or far away

their.def: belonging to them; shows something is of those people

they.def: used for two or more people or things already talked about

thing.def: an object, idea, or fact that you do not name

think.def: to use your mind about something

today.def: this day; the day that is happening now

too.def: more than is good or needed

up.def: awake and out of bed; also, toward a higher place

very.def: makes a word stronger; a lot

video.def: moving pictures you record and watch on a screen

wait.def: to stay until someone comes or something happens

want.def: to wish to have or do something

watch.def: to look at something for some time

way.def: how to go somewhere or how to do something

we.ex: We eat dinner together every night.

we'd.def: short for we would or we had

wear.def: to have clothes on your body

website.def: a group of pages on the internet about something

wedding.def: a party when two people get married

week.ex: I go to the gym three times a week.

weird.ex: That's a weird noise. What is it?

welcome.def: a word to say you are happy someone has come

what.def: used to ask about a thing or information

what's.def: short for what is or what has

when.def: at what time; at the time that

where.def: used to ask about a place

who.def: used to ask about a person

whole.def: all of something; complete, with no part missing

why.def: used to ask for the reason

will.def: shows something is going to happen in the future

win.def: to be the best or first in a game

with.def: together; in the same place as someone

woman.ex: The woman at reception is very kind.

wonderful.ex: We had a wonderful time at the beach.

work.def: effort you make to do something; a job

worried.def: feeling afraid that something bad may happen

worry.def: to feel afraid that something bad may happen
worry.ex: Mom worries when Adam comes home late.

would.def: used to ask or say something politely

wow.def: said when you are very surprised or impressed

write.def: to put words on paper or a screen

wrong.def: not correct; not the right one
wrong.ex: Sorry, I called the wrong number.

yes.def: a word to agree or say something is true

you.def: the person or people I am talking to
